fields.name: Topics
fields.about: Each topic that we want to delete records from.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: Each partition that we want to delete records from.

fields.name: Offset
fields.about: The deletion offset. -1 means that records should be truncated to the high watermark.

fields.name: TimeoutMs
fields.about: How long to wait for the deletion to complete, in milliseconds.
